gcal.scope: Generate and optionally replace a CASA-compatible WVR T Jones table. Write the named diagnostic log and return the CASA integer completion status.

behaviors.title: Radiometer phase correction
behaviors.scope: Native CASA-readable T Jones gains from seeded water-vapour retrievals, atmospheric paths and spectral-window phase conversion. Includes task reports, direct logging, smoothing and antenna replacement.
behaviors.gap: The compact fixtures have been compared with CASA 6.7.6.14. The recorded ALMA case is pending under #1531.

decisions.record: WVR global phase reversal can miss sparse spectral-window selections
decisions.inputs: A direct wvr.gcal invocation with global phase reversal and a sparse spectral-window selection.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6.14 can leave selected windows unchanged when the selected position differs from the actual ID.
decisions.ours: Reverse the phase of every selected spectral-window ID.
decisions.rationale: Match the documented phase operation and the algebraic conjugation of the ordinary gains.
decisions.impact: A sparse output selection produces the same reversed phases as the corresponding subset of an all-window reversal.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

two-seeds-and-application.kind: Seeded WVR phase, CASA applycal and solver preapply
two-seeds-and-application.scope: Compare the nominal T Jones table, continuum table and log, corrected visibilities and recovery of injected gains across both engines.
two-seeds-and-application.result: Two ordinary seeds, four applycal pairings and four preapply pairings passed.

parameter-options.scope: Compare selected products and antenna reports with the installed task or tool on the same input. Exercise offsets, source controls, flags, dispersion, smoothing, references and failure paths.
parameter-options.result: 19 paired cases and the zero-evidence retry passed. Maximum gain normalized RMS 1.92e-09.
